title: Make a list at build time
summary: A static data array can become HTML during the Astro build.
introduction: A static data array can become HTML during the Astro build. Your task: Add a third title and rebuild.
learningObjectives: Add a third title and rebuild.
Explain the example for make a list at build time

blocks.text: A static data array can become HTML during the Astro build. The browser receives the finished list without needing to run the map call.
Use an Astro project. Save examples at the shown src paths. Astro files are built into HTML and need the Astro tool; they do not run as plain HTML in this playground.

blocks.title: Make a list at build time

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The array contains two title values.
The map returns one list item per title while Astro makes the final HTML.

blocks.text: The output HTML has one list item for each title.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Changing the source array needs a rebuild for a static site. This is not live database data.

blocks.text: Add a third title and rebuild.
